title: Psychological Safety Indicators to Complement Existing Workplace Well-being Initiatives
what_it_is: Psychological Safety Indicators to Complement Existing Workplace Well-being Initiatives

sections.label: MOM on workplace psychological safety
sections.summary: MOM supports employers in assessing workplace mental well-being holistically, citing iWorkHealth and the Tripartite Advisory, rather than developing national psychological safety indicators.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Acting Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Manpower (MOM) recognises the role of psychological safety in fostering a positive work environment where employees feel comfortable in raising their ideas and views.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Acting Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: MOM's approach is to support employers to assess and address mental well-being in their workplaces holistically rather than develop national level indicators or benchmarks for psychological safety alone.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Acting Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: For example, we have developed iWorkHealth, an online psychosocial health assessment tool that employers can use to identify common workplace stressors and psychosocial risks.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Acting Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Participating employers will receive an aggregated, anonymised report on the key work stressors or risks affecting their workforce, including psychological safety within the organisation.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Acting Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: They will also receive recommendations to address the findings, which can be complemented by other resources on fostering a supportive workplace culture such as the Tripartite Advisory on Mental Health and Well-being at Workplaces.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: In fact, for this particular case, there is no single stakeholder that can act alone.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: I suggest for Government employers and unions work together to foster a more conducive culture and ecosystem.
